clips.title: The story
paras: Felix's Bucket of Bolts is a container of spare hardware and tools owned by Felix Whindlebolt, a gnome refugee who fled the fall of Gnomeregan. During his escape into Dun Morogh, the bucket was snatched by local Frostmane trolls and dragged into their nearby camps.

When radiation flooded Gnomeregan following the disaster against the troggs, thousands of gnomes fled into the freezing wilds of Dun Morogh with whatever they could carry. Felix Whindlebolt managed to escape with his vital equipment, but in the chaos of his flight toward Anvilmar, he was ambushed by the Frostmane trolls who inhabit the crags southwest of town. The trolls plundered his belongings, including this bucket full of bolts and parts, leaving the artisan stranded without the essential materials needed to ply his craft in exile.
